title: Chat
description: Presentation-only chat components — ChatMessage, ChatComposer, ChatHistory, ChatTimeline, and the composed ChatShell. Dumb on purpose: render the data you hand them, emit callbacks, no LLM coupling.

tool.name: mount_chat
tool.description: Mount the Chat demo — the standalone primitives plus a composed ChatShell driven by static data, including a message-snippet seam that switches on data.kind.

props.name: messages
props.desc: Conversation turns rendered in the timeline, oldest first.

props.name: conversations
props.desc: Optional history list; presence toggles the sidebar.

props.name: activeConversationId
props.desc: Marks the active row in the history sidebar.

props.name: busy
props.desc: Locks the composer while a response is in flight.

props.name: onsubmit
props.desc: Fires when the user sends (Enter, no Shift).

props.name: message
props.desc: Per-message render override — switch on msg.data?.kind for rich content.

attrs.desc: Root of the composed shell; [data-has-history] present when conversations are passed.
One bubble; data-role is user / assistant / system, data-status optional.
Scrolling message list; auto-scrolls to newest.
